All dependencies are cached — the timeout is in my helpers' SMT proofs (each `euclid_finish` can take up to 300s). I'll build them one at a time, logging to persistent files so partial progress survives a timeout, and the next run resumes from cache.

<<<RUN cwd=LeanEuclidPlus>>>
source ~/.venvs/leaneuclid/bin/activate
LOG=/tmp/p36_master.log
: > $LOG
for m in step5 step6 step7 step8 step9 Main; do
  echo "=== BUILD $m START $(date +%s) ===" >> $LOG
  lake build Book1.Prop36.$m > /tmp/p36_$m.log 2>&1
  ec=$?
  echo "=== $m EXIT $ec $(date +%s) ===" >> $LOG
  grep -iE "error:|sorry|: failed|unsolved" /tmp/p36_$m.log | grep -v -- "--load-dynlib" | head -15 >> $LOG
done
echo "ALLDONE" >> $LOG
cat $LOG
<<<END>>>
